cases.title: No connection
cases.question: What does the user see offline, and is their work kept until they are back?
cases.expected: Keep the basket and slot, say the order was not placed, retry when back online.

cases.title: No answer in time
cases.question: After how long does it give up, and what can the user do then?
cases.expected: After a time limit, show the definite order state (looked up on the server) instead of a generic error.

cases.title: The other system returns an error
cases.question: Is the message specific, and is there a retry or another route?
cases.expected: Specific message, safe retry, basket and slot kept.

cases.title: Button pressed twice
cases.question: Can a double press create two records, charges or messages?
cases.expected: A second press must not create a second order or charge. Disable the button on press and make the request idempotent.

cases.title: Half of it worked
cases.question: If only part succeeded, what state is the user left in and how do they finish?
cases.expected: If payment succeeds but the order fails (or the reverse), reconcile automatically and tell the customer which state they are in.

cases.title: Data changed since the screen loaded
cases.question: If price, stock, permissions or status changed meanwhile, who wins?
cases.expected: If a price or stock level changed between review and placement, show the change and ask once before charging.

cases.title: Nothing to show yet
cases.question: What does a first-time or zero-data user see, and what should they do next?
cases.expected: A customer with no past order should not see the entry points, or should see a starter basket.
cases.note: The spec lists this as undecided; in the simulation about nine in ten new customers who start are blocked.

cases.step_name: Confirms payment with the saved card
cases.title: Saved card is expired or will be declined
cases.question: When is the card checked, and what happens to the basket and slot if it fails?
cases.expected: Check the expiry date when the sheet opens; on decline, stay in the flow, hold the slot, offer another payment method.

cases.title: Customer wants only some of the items
cases.question: Can items be unticked or quantities changed?
cases.expected: Allow untick and quantity change in the sheet; otherwise one-off orders make reorder useless.

cases.title: Signed out while in the flow
cases.question: After signing in again, do they return to where they were?
cases.expected: Sign in again and return to the same step with the basket intact.
cases.note: Lower than the default: sessions on a phone app rarely expire inside a one-minute flow.

cases.title: Typed data lost on error or navigation
cases.question: If the step fails or the user steps back, is what they typed kept?
cases.expected: A slot error must not reset stock decisions made in the previous step.

cases.title: Second and tenth use
cases.question: Is the repeat experience shorter than the first, and are earlier choices remembered?
cases.expected: On repeat use, remember the usual slot and substitute choices.

cases.title: Most or all items are unavailable
cases.question: What does the sheet show when little of the last order can be bought today?
cases.expected: Say so up front and offer the regular shop instead of an empty reorder.

cases.title: Removing items drops the basket below the minimum order value
cases.question: Is the minimum checked after removals, and what is offered?
cases.expected: Show the shortfall and suggest items to add.

cases.title: Page refresh or app restart mid-flow
cases.question: Is progress restored or does the user start again?

cases.title: Link opens the middle of the flow
cases.question: What happens if someone lands on step 3 without doing steps 1 and 2?

cases.title: Same flow open in two tabs or devices
cases.question: Which one wins, and can the two conflict?

cases.title: Role or access changes mid-flow
cases.question: If access is removed while the user is in the flow, what do they see?

cases.title: Interrupted and resumed days later
cases.question: Is a half-done flow kept, expired or cleaned up, and is the user reminded?

cases.title: Keyboard only
cases.question: Can the whole flow be completed without a mouse, in a sensible focus order?

cases.title: Screen reader
cases.question: Are states, errors and progress announced?

cases.title: Small phone screen
cases.question: Is the main button reachable without scrolling past everything?

cases.title: Nothing to show yet
cases.question: What does a first-time or zero-data user see, and what should they do next?

cases.title: None of the choices fit
cases.question: Is there an 'other', a skip, or a way to ask for help?

cases.title: User wants to change the choice later
cases.question: Can they go back or change it afterwards without starting over?

cases.title: User accepts the default without reading
cases.question: Is the default safe for someone who never looks at it?

cases.title: Submitted empty
cases.question: What does the user see if they submit with nothing entered?

cases.title: Wrong format
cases.question: Is the error shown next to the field, in plain words, before or after submit?

cases.title: Zero, negative, decimal or huge numbers
cases.question: Which are allowed, and what is the message for the rest?

cases.title: Value that already exists
cases.question: Is a duplicate rejected, merged or allowed, and does the user understand which?

cases.title: On-screen keyboard hides the field or button
cases.question: On a phone, can the user still see what they type and reach the button?
